font_config._doc: Font whitelist for Step 3 (docs/prepare_cpt_dataset.md). Matching is on the font name without the subset prefix (ABCDEF+). convert = legacy FM-encoded Sinhala; keep = already Unicode or Latin; drop = other scripts and dingbats. s01_inventory.py lists every font that is in none of these lists, with sample text: classify it here before running s02 (legacy Sinhala can hide behind any name, e.g. F2, R1, KELANI-Plain). punct_keep lists, per font, ASCII characters that are real punctuation in that font and must NOT go through the FM table (check against the printed page). Classified from the Easy (g6-g8) inventory on 2026-10-15.

patches: P1 upstream regex bugs: f\da / f\d (\d = any digit) -> f|da / f|d (ඳෝ ඳො); f\\{da / f\\{d -> f{da / f{d (ඥෝ ඥො)

P2 nasal prefix ` + consonant code -> the code of the pre-nasalised letter (`o -> | = ඳ, `v -> ~ = ඬ, `. -> Õ = ඟ, `n -> U = ඹ, `ÿ -> ÷ = ඳු, `È -> ¢ = ඳි ...), mapped before the base table so the f (ෙ) prefix rules still apply; any ` left before ද ඩ ග බ after conversion is fixed in POST
P3 ¥ -> දූ and ¨ -> ලු (upstream: missing / ලූ); ª -> ඳු, ý -> ඡි, \ -> ඳ (rare glyphs found in the audit)
P4 delete the • -> x rule; ¡ and ² -> •; ⋆ (from ³) -> •
P5 % -> ්‍ර without a leading ZWJ; strip stray '=' from upstream outputs (ඡ= රැ= ඳැ= ඤු= ඤූ=)
P6 per-font punctuation kept as-is (config/fonts.json: punct_keep)
P7 ligatures ﬁ ﬂ -> fi fl before conversion
P8 delete the early & -> ) rule: its output was turned into * by the later ) -> * rule; the final & -> ) rule (after it) gives the right )
P9 · before a digit -> × (magnification ×5, ×40 in science)
P10 vowel sign written before the rakaransaya / yansaya -> after it (ගාබි්‍රයෙල් -> ගාබ්‍රියෙල්)

P11 Easy s02 leftovers, checked on the printed page: `ã -> ඬී, `t and `: -> ළු (මාළු ඇතුළු), ` dropped before ¯ ® | (මජ්ඣිම සඳහා), consonant + ` + vowel sign (o`d -> ඳා), `` -> `, `c -> ඦ, μ after a letter -> ද්‍ය (වෛද්‍ය), Ω before ¿ and the Ohm sign U+2126 dropped (එළවළු, මනඃ)
P12 roman numerals: » -> I (the table used » as its own placeholder for the comma), ¼ -> V
P13 · not before a digit -> • (bullets); ASCII control characters removed
P15 last Easy leftovers: `X -> ඬ (බුඬ ගජ්ඣ), `Co -> ඤ (alphabet table), a line holding only ` -> dropped
P14 per line, across spans: ` + ඵ -> ළු; Ω doubled by an FM span and a Times span -> one Ω; same for a » bullet
